question: By what method should the six-limb ritual be performed in this context?
premises: The six-limb ritual is to be performed.
It is done by means of the six-four-directions formula.
inference: One should perform the six-limb nyāsa using the six-four-directions method.
uncertainties: The technical meaning of ṣaṭcaturdikaka is not fully explicit in this verse.
plain_english: One should perform the six-limb ritual by means of the six-four-directions method.
